items.title: Settings: removing a repo removes its reviews too
items.summary: Removing a repo in Settings → Repos no longer refuses while it has reviews: it removes the repo's reviews too (with the worktrees Unvibe made for them; your folder is never touched). The confirm says what goes: "Remove <repo> and its N reviews from Unvibe? <path> is not touched.", and "N unsent drafts will be lost" when those reviews hold Outbox drafts.
items.whatChanged: Removing a repo in Settings → Repos no longer refuses while it has reviews: it removes the repo's reviews too (with the worktrees Unvibe made for them; your folder is never touched). The confirm says what goes: "Remove <repo> and its N reviews from Unvibe? <path> is not touched.", and "N unsent drafts will be lost" when those reviews hold Outbox drafts.
items.whatToTry: Open Settings → Repos, click Remove on a repo that has a review: the confirm names the review. Confirm: the repo and the review are gone from Settings and the start page, and the folder is still there.
items.caveats: Refused (nothing removed) while one of the repo's reviews is being submitted.
